Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the run-through yesterday. Quick follow-ups as we lock the logistics for Acme's leadership workshop (Nov 16-18):

- Attrition: we need clarity on the attrition percentage and how it scales with room pickup. Our legal needs a sample addendum clause for review (we prefer a sliding scale rather than a flat penalty).
- ADA / accessible rooms: can you hold a minimum of 3 ADA/accessible rooms within the main block? Two attendees have mobility needs and one prefers roll-in shower.
- Master-bill: Redwood will handle a single master-bill for meeting rooms + F&B. Billing code: P-ACCT-3481. Any preferred PO reference we should include?
- Early check-in / complimentary upgrades: any options for early check-in (between 9–11am) for ~6 people and two potential complimentary upgrades for execs?
- Catering: is breakfast included in the meeting room package or billed separately?

Attaching a draft rooming list (exec_rooming_draft.csv) with preliminary preferences. Please attach a redlined addendum and an estimate that shows the attrition tiers.

Goal: get a draft addendum and a sample invoice by Friday so Acme procurement can sign off.

Thanks,
Michael

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Hotel rates, attrition addendum, ADA block and master-bill logistics

Hi Michael —

Great to connect. Summary below and next steps in bold.

1) Rates and attrition
- Published corporate rate (single/double): $259/$279.
- Attrition: standard 80% pickup threshold with tiered penalties: 79–70% = 25% room revenue penalty, 69–60% = 50%, <60% = full penalty.
- We can offer a softer sliding scale for group of this size: 85% threshold for year-end events with 10% penalty for 84–80%, 30% for 79–70%. I attached a sample addendum (hotel_masterbill_addendum_v1.pdf) with that language.

2) ADA rooms and holds
- We will reserve 3 ADA rooms in the main tower (including 1 with roll-in shower). Please provide names so we can ensure room placement.

3) Early check-in / upgrades
- Early check-in: limited on a guaranteed basis; we can offer 3 guaranteed early check-ins and priority arrival for the rest (based on availability).
- Complimentary upgrades: two one-night upgrades for senior execs as a courtesy, subject to availability.

4) Master-bill and PO
- We can put meeting room charges and agreed F&B on one master-bill. Please include billing code P-ACCT-3481 in the PO reference. For third-party travel (Global Travel), note that incidental guest charges must settle individually unless pre-arranged.

Next steps (bold):
- Please review the attached addendum and confirm whether the softer attrition tiers are acceptable.
- Provide the three ADA room names and any special meal needs.
- Sign the master-bill addendum via DocuSign (link included below) and return the exec rooming CSV with final pickup numbers by 2026-10-08.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/Signing?exampleId=ABC123
Catering contact: Maria Delgado <maria.delgado@hiltoncatering.com>

Best,
Samantha Rhodes
Group Sales Manager
Hilton Downtown
